settings.name: status
settings.description: Who registered the client: registered (12.2 explicit) or auto_registered (12.1); a client without it was created by an administrator, and neither registration path touches it

when_wrong.detail: Not declared in PingFederate: the registration is refused and the client disabled

settings.name: trust_chain
settings.description: The trust chain the client was registered with

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: application_type
settings.description: application_type from the client's metadata

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: subject_type
settings.description: subject_type from the client's metadata

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: contacts
settings.description: contacts from the client's metadata

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: attestation_required
settings.description: Written true when the client's metadata asks for client attestation

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: federation_registration_expires_at
settings.description: When the registration ends, in epoch seconds: never later than its trust chain (12.3)

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the registration counts as expired

settings.name: federation_trust_anchor
settings.description: The trust anchor the registration's chain reached; the token-issuance decision is asked with it

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: federation_entity_type
settings.description: The Entity Type the client was registered from

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: federation_registration_disabled_at
settings.description: When this module disabled the client because its registration expired, in epoch seconds; only a client carrying it is enabled again by a renewal

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: attestation_pop_max_age
settings.description: The oldest a client attestation's proof of possession may be, for this client

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning

settings.name: attestation_dpop_max_age
settings.description: The oldest a DPoP proof presented with an attestation may be, for this client

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning

settings.name: attestation_clock_skew
settings.description: The clock skew allowed when checking this client's attestation, in seconds

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning; past an int it wraps

settings.name: attestation_challenge_required
settings.description: Whether this client's attestation proof must carry a server-issued challenge

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true, in any case, means false

settings.name: attestation_expected_htu
settings.description: An administrator's pin of the htu a DPoP proof names, in place of the token endpoint's URL

when_wrong.detail: A wrong value refuses every proof

settings.name: attestation_accepted_algs
settings.description: What this client's attestation may be signed with, comma-separated

when_wrong.detail: An algorithm no attester uses refuses every attestation

settings.name: attestation_pop_algs
settings.description: What this client's attestation proof may be signed with, comma-separated

when_wrong.detail: An algorithm the client does not use refuses every proof

settings.name: attestation_dpop_algs
settings.description: What a DPoP proof with this client's attestation may be signed with, comma-separated

when_wrong.detail: An algorithm the client does not use refuses every proof

settings.name: attestation_required_claims
settings.description: The top-level claims this client's attestation must carry, comma-separated; unset, oidf.attestation.required.claims

when_wrong.detail: A claim the attester does not send refuses every attestation

settings.name: trust_chain_leaf_max_time
settings.description: The longest the leaf's Entity Configuration in a presented chain may live, in seconds, at the OGNL chain criterion; -1 is no limit

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning

settings.name: trust_chain_trustanchor_max_time
settings.description: The longest the trust anchor's statement in a presented chain may live, in seconds, at the OGNL chain criterion; -1 is no limit

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning

settings.name: trust_chain_request_max_age
settings.description: The oldest a statement in a chain presented at the token endpoint may be, in seconds; -1 is no limit. The attestation criterion's default is -1, not 60 (F-0199)

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the default
